title: How Turning His Screen Gray Broke a Godly Man's Scroll
caption:
A godly man broke his scroll with one setting.

Grayscale killed the pull color was selling him.

Find the color that's hooking you. Make the next tap boring on purpose. Notice what you reach for instead. Let the gray wear off, not the fight.

He's just a man who doesn't reach for his phone first. That's the win the setting bought him time to build.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #digitaldiscipline #selfcontrol #phonefree
